unit: 1 m wide slit: scale = 2 * EyeField.EyeWidth * size (0.15 per unit size)
pivot: eyeball centre; the eye looks along local +Z in Unity

rig.unity_rule: turn the EyeRig.R vertices about axis_unity through the pivot so the upper lid's front edge moves down by upper_lid_deg x blink, the EyeRig.G vertices so the lower lid's edge moves up by lower_lid_deg x blink; EyeRig.B vertices turn by Look.deg for a look

vertex_colours: EyeRig: R upper lid, G lower lid, B eyeball + cornea (rotate about rig.axis_unity through the pivot: lids by Blink deg x weight, eyeball for looks)
emission: iris only, meant for EyeField.Emission 5 (HDR) with bloom
